reader_summary.headline: Alex is the founder of Convoke, a software platform to help streamline drug development and commercialization.
reader_summary.overview: Alex is the founder of Convoke, a software platform to help streamline drug development and commercialization. He also has been writing frequent blog posts on the biotech industry since 2019, keeping a pulse on the direction of innovation. He joined me today to talk about the history of the pharmaceutical industry and what’s becoming possible in medicine in the coming years.

key_points.text: Alex helped break down the complexities of investing in new drug development, breakthroughs in gene therapy on the horizon.
This industry has a lot to unpack, and he thoughtfully lays out the landscape.
Please enjoy my conversation with Alex Telford.
